documented cases are not presented as proof of personal orders.","closed_system_silence":"Security-force abuse, detention, emergency governance, and refugee mistreatment may be systematically underreported where access and oversight are constrained.","duplicate_reporting":"Amnesty and State Department material reproduced through ecoi.net are not independent copies; WEB-3B-09 and related European Commission observations overlap with other institutional assessments.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Both favorable and adverse material was located, including relief, formal safeguards, disciplinary action, courts, hotlines, and counterterrorism capacity alongside abuse and protection gaps; the European Commission and Freedom House provide partly overlapping assessments rather than wholly independent event records.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Both were performed: genuine alternatives, high turnout, orderly administration, opposition participation, and some institutional functioning are recorded alongside incumbent advantage and restrictions; research was not fully saturated.","missing_source_type":"Missing primary election-body datasets, complete complaint decisions, campaign-finance records, local-language media monitoring, and independent judicial case files.","official_claim_independence":"OSCE/ODIHR provides substantial independent observation; official election-body claims are checked for procedures but transparency and reason-giving remain limited.","open_system_complaint_volume":"Election observation and civil-society reporting may emphasize visible violations and organized complaints, though restricted media and remedy systems may suppress the true volume.","population_exposure_authority_baseline_shocks":"High participation, election timing, incumbent authority, opposition access, media exposure, institutional baselines, and inherited presidential-system conditions are addressed; full saturation was not achieved.","missing_source_type":"Missing IMF or central-bank primary series and decisions, procurement-level contract and ownership records, household distributional data, and independent evaluation of earthquake spending.","official_claim_independence":"The Commission synthesizes official and external inputs, but official macroeconomic claims and post-election policy intentions need independent outcome verification.","open_system_complaint_volume":"Procurement and corruption reporting may overrepresent visible institutional risks; outcomes are not automatically treated as ruler misconduct.","closed_system_silence":"Centralized administration and emergency conditions may suppress complaints about relief allocation, discrimination, service denial, and reconstruction failures.","duplicate_reporting":"The European Commission and U.S. State Department reports incorporate overlapping government, NGO, and international material; research rounds did not reach full saturation.","missing_source_type":"Missing household surveys, facility-level service and reconstruction audits, local administrative records, beneficiary complaint data, and independent expenditure tracking.","official_claim_independence":"International reports provide some external checking, but official relief and statistical claims are not fully validated against beneficiary-level outcomes.","open_system_complaint_volume":"Rights and service complaints may overrepresent severe or accessible cases; disaster displacement and weak access can also reduce complaint reporting and hide unmet need.","population_exposure_authority_baseline_shocks":"The earthquake, refugees, Roma communities, women, disabled people, health and education exposure, centralized authority, and inherited disadvantage are addressed, but denominators, local variation, and pre-shock baselines remain incomplete.","supporting_evidence_ids":["ER-03","WEB-6B-01","WEB-6B-02","WEB-6B-03","WEB-6B-04","WEB-6B-05","WEB-6B-06","WEB-6B-07","WEB-6B-08","WEB-6B-09","WEB-6B-10"],"unresolved_risks":["One lens has an explicit local evidence gap.","Pledges, policies, and reported service availability are not equivalent to completed outcomes.","The earthquake is a major external shock, so attribution requires careful separation of damage from response quality."]},"chapter_id":"6B","defensible_evidence_estimate":8,"independent_source_family_estimate":4,"missing_themes":["6B.10"],"substantive_issues":["WEB-6B-10 is an index of releases, not extracted outcome data, and should remain discovery/context only.","The evidence supports documented access and accountability concerns but not a comprehensive welfare-outcome estimate."]},{"attribution_risk":"high","bias_review":{"allegations_vs_findings":"The notebook carefully states that institutional corruption and accountability risks are not proof of Erdoğan’s personal enrichment; the personal-integrity search was not fully saturated.","missing_source_type":"Missing primary asset declarations, beneficial-ownership and tax records, procurement-contract trails, audit findings, final judgments, GRECO follow-up records, and independently corroborated personal-integrity investigations.","official_claim_independence":"International assessments and election observation independently assess institutions, but official anti-corruption claims and formal legal safeguards do not establish effectiveness or personal integrity.","open_system_complaint_volume":"Open corruption and governance indicators may overrepresent visible institutional weakness and perceptions; repeated chapter packaging does not create independent evidence.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Both favorable and adverse evidence was located: programs, investment planning, appointments, policy correction, mobilization, and formal targets versus inflation, weak accountability, uneven elections, and transparency gaps; full saturation was not achieved.","missing_source_type":"Missing audited program-performance data, budget and project completion records, outcome indicators tied to the stated targets, parliamentary oversight records, and independent local implementation evidence.","official_claim_independence":"OSCE/ODIHR and European Commission provide external checks, but presidential, ministry, and central-bank statements primarily establish claimed actions or intentions, not realized effectiveness.","open_system_complaint_volume":"Visible election and rights complaints may exaggerate apparent severity relative to unobserved governance performance, while centralized information control may hide implementation failures and complaints.","population_exposure_authority_baseline_shocks":"Executive authority, inherited inflation, earthquake shock, election context, security and foreign-policy constraints, and formal objectives are addressed; neither should be treated as dispositive of overall effectiveness."]},"chapter_id":"8B","defensible_evidence_estimate":8,"independent_source_family_estimate":5,"missing_themes":["8B.7","8B.10"],"substantive_issues":["The notebook supports a governing-system account but leaves material gaps in measured outcomes and target attainment.","WEB-8B-01 is a secondary program summary rather than the original legal text, and several official claims report intentions rather than verified results."]}],"global_findings":["Research rounds were exhausted without full saturation. This is a terminal research conclusion, not a claim that the dossier is complete.","No scores, score ranges, ranking recommendations, or judge-directed advice were assigned.","Missing evidence was treated as an evidence gap rather than negative ruler evidence.","The notebook contains substantial duplicate source-family reuse, especially European Commission, OSCE/ODIHR, IAEA-hosted, and ecoi.net-reproduced material; raw item counts therefore overstate independent corroboration.","Several credible recoverable gaps remain, including inaccessible or unextracted primary documents, missing transaction- and case-level records, insufficient outcome measurement, and unresolved personal attribution in Chapter 7B.","Gateway, catalogue, index, and bounded synthesis items were excluded from defensible evidence counts where they did not provide precise underlying support.","Local-fact and indicator material was treated as contextual unless the notebook supplied sufficient ruler attribution and target-period fit."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal no-search evidence review for Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s 2023 ruler-period. The dossier contains meaningful, target-period evidence across all chapters, but defensibility varies: election and macro-institutional findings are comparatively strong; operational security, welfare outcomes, nuclear implementation, and especially personal integrity remain more weakly attributed or incompletely measured. Research rounds were exhausted without full saturation. Residual gaps are preserved for downstream confidence and interpretation, and no chapter is represented as complete.","schema_version":"ruler_evidence_review_v1","selected_theme_ids":[]}
